responsePromise: Quote back within a few hours, seven days a week.

process.step: Send us a photo and a measurement
process.detail: A photo with a tape measure in it is usually enough for a guide price.
Glass is cut to the millimetre, so we measure on site before anything is ordered.
We fit it, seal it and take the old glass away.

faq.q: How fast can you come for a broken window?
faq.a: We board up same day where we can, then fit the new glass once it is cut.
Double costs more and is quieter and warmer. On a main road or a cold room it pays for itself; on a sheltered side it may not.

faq.q: Do you take the old glass away?
faq.a: Yes, and we clean up. Broken glass is not something to leave with a customer.
Safety glass is required in bathrooms, doors and low windows. Everything we fit meets the standard and we will tell you where it applies.
